fields.meta_description: Build a consulting landing page from a prompt. See examples that book discovery calls, route partners, and read RFPs. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Consulting Landing Page That Books Discovery Calls
fields.hero_description: Build a consulting landing page that books discovery calls and saves each prospect's answers to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds for a Consulting Practice
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the consulting landing page, the questions a prospect answers before booking, and the table that keeps every answer.
fields.feature_1:
Your engagements, written into a page

Describe the problems you solve and for which firms. Emergent builds a page from that prompt with the offer and your method, then past results and a call request. Prompt to edit it.
fields.feature_2:
Scoping questions before the call

Ask what you would ask in the first five minutes of a meeting: company size, the problem, the deadline. The app keeps each answer with the request, and you arrive briefed.
fields.feature_3:
Prospects in a database you own

Every request lands in a database you own, with the prospect's answers, the page they came from, and the booked time on one row. Sort by budget or date to pick who hears back first.
fields.feature_4:
An alert to the partner who answers

Name who answers each kind of request. The app sends that person a Slack message, an email, or an in-app alert with the answers, then a reminder if the request sits unanswered.
fields.feature_5:
Booked calls that reach your CRM

The app connects to any tool with an API, such as HubSpot. A booked call arrives in your CRM as a new contact with its scoping answers, and your pipeline matches your calendar.
fields.feature_6:
Hosted on your domain, exported as code

Publish the page on your firm's domain; custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and keep building.

fields.tab_content_1:
Three scoping answers ride along in the calendar invite

Visitors to Tamblyn Strategy answer three questions: company size, the problem, and the timeline. The page then shows Anouk Lindqvist's open 30-minute slots, and the app writes the answers into the calendar invite. Of 19 calls booked in October, Teodor Batista of Velmora Cold Storage took Thursday at 10:00 AM.
fields.tab_content_2:
Pricing lands with Dashiell, supply chain with Keshav

Halvorsen Ridge Advisory has three partners. The page asks which practice a request is about and messages that partner in Slack. Of 27 September requests, 9 went to Keshav Ambrose (supply chain), 6 to Brielle Mancuso (org design), and 12 to Dashiell Okafor (pricing), including Yusuf Halloran of Glenhaven Foods.
fields.tab_content_3:
An uploaded RFP becomes a due date, a budget, and a scope

A prospect uploads an RFP to Sunnbrook IT Advisory's page, and the app reads the due date, budget, and scope into fields. Any field it is unsure of goes to Ingeborg Achterhof. Of 14 RFPs in the third quarter, Wendlebury Dental Group's was due November 14 with a $40,000 budget, and its scope went to Ingeborg.
fields.tab_content_4:
The morning after, every attendee gets a call link

Juniper Vasquez, an operations consultant, fills her calendar with a free 60-minute workshop on cutting warehouse pick errors. Registration closes at 40 seats, and the morning after, the app emails each attendee a link to book a discovery call. Of the 40, 31 attended and 11 booked a call, Odell Ferris first.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Consulting Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Follow seven steps to plan a consulting landing page around one engagement, then publish it with call booking on your domain.
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down the one engagement you want more of, such as a pricing review for food distributors. Name the buyer who signs off on the fee and the problem they would bring to a first call. Every section speaks to that person.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Open on the problem as a buyer would describe it to a colleague, such as margins slipping after a supplier price rise. Put your method, the people doing the work, and your credentials lower on the page, for readers who want to know how.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write two or three short case summaries: the kind of company and its problem, then the result in numbers. Where a client has not agreed to be named, describe them by industry and size instead of by name.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Pick three or four questions that shape how you prepare for the call, such as how soon they need results and what they can spend. Stop there: a busy buyer should reach the booking step in under a minute.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the page in one prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Describe the page to Emergent in one prompt: the engagement, the scoping questions, the length of the call, and who gets the alert. Emergent builds a page that carries the booking step and a table of requests.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Set the hours you take calls
fields.howto_step_6_des: Decide which hours you take discovery calls and how much space you need between them. Leave 15 minutes before each one to read the prospect's answers. The opening minutes then go on their problem instead of basics.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Book a test call, then publish
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book a test call yourself and check that the row lands in your table and the invite carries your answers. Then publish on your firm's domain and add the link to your email signature and proposals.

faq_plan.q: What is a consulting landing page?
faq_plan.a: A consulting landing page is a single page that sells one consulting engagement to one kind of buyer and asks for one step, such as booking a discovery call. It names the problem the firm solves, who it solves it for, how an engagement runs, and what past clients gained. It has no site menu: every link on it leads to that step.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a consulting landing page?
faq_plan.a: Describe the engagement and the call you want buyers to book in one prompt to Emergent's AI landing page builder. Emergent builds the page with its scoping questions and booking step, plus the database that stores each request. Prompt again to change the copy or add a question, then publish.

faq_plan.q: What should a consultant landing page include?
faq_plan.a: Include the problem you solve in the buyer's words, the kind of company you work with, the stages of a project, proof from past work, and one way to book a call. Leave the full service list and the firm history on your main site, and link to them from the footer.

faq_plan.q: How is a consulting landing page different from a coaching page?
faq_plan.a: Build a consulting page around a project with a scope and a business buyer: lead with the problem and the results in numbers. A coaching landing page sells sessions with one person, and it leads with the change that person wants to make and how the sessions run.

faq_plan.q: What questions should a consulting landing page ask before a discovery call?
faq_plan.a: Ask only what changes how you prepare: the problem in one sentence, the deadline, and a budget range. Offer the budget as ranges to pick from instead of a blank number field, and make it optional if buyers balk at it. The app saves every answer in a database you own, next to the booked time.

faq_plan.q: Should a consulting landing page show prices?
faq_plan.a: Show a starting price when it screens out buyers you cannot serve, such as a line that says projects start at $15,000. Leave price off when scope varies too widely to quote before a call, and say instead that the discovery call ends with a written estimate.

faq_plan.q: Does a consulting landing page for a small firm differ from one for a solo consultant?
faq_plan.a: Yes, in one place: routing. A firm with several partners needs each request to reach the right person. Ask which practice the request is about and alert that partner. Everything else on the page works the same way. A design agency landing page differs more, because it leads with a portfolio of visual work.

faq_plan.q: Should a consulting landing page use a booking calendar or a request form?
faq_plan.a: Use a booking calendar when you will take any call that passes your scoping questions, and a request form when you want to read the answers before you offer a time. Emergent builds either from the same prompt, and you can switch later by prompting again.

faq_plan.q: How long should a consulting landing page be?
faq_plan.a: Long enough to answer what a buyer checks before booking, and no longer. Five or six sections on one scroll cover a single engagement. Give a second engagement its own page, built from another prompt to Emergent.

faq_plan.q: How do I get a consulting landing page to show up in search?
faq_plan.a: Put the engagement and the buyer in the page title and H1, such as pricing reviews for food distributors, and write a meta description that says what the page offers. Google sometimes uses the meta description HTML element for the snippet when it describes the page more accurately than its text. The landing page seo guide covers the rest.

plan.angle: The top 10 for consulting landing page is design galleries and template downloads (UIHut, Dribbble, Behance, Nicepage, stock vectors) plus one agency guide and a Wix roundup: layouts with nothing behind them. This page shows four consulting pages built from a prompt and what each does with a prospect on the way to a discovery call: a strategy firm whose visitors book an open 30-minute slot after three scoping questions, a three-partner firm that sends each request to the partner for that practice area, an IT advisory that reads uploaded RFPs into due date, budget and scope, and an operations consultant whose free workshop invites attendees to a call the next morning. The FAQ covers the definition, the build, what a consultant page needs, how it differs from a coaching page, scoping questions, proof without naming clients, agency versus solo pages, booking versus a contact form, pricing on the page, and search visibility. Coaching, service, personal and freelancer pages are siblings and stay out of the headings.
